title: Thursday · the week after
logline: The parody ends. Drift Wood returns. Wood at two-thirds his usual size. Gully, normal.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD at the drafting table drawn at two-thirds his normal size in a panel that is otherwise the usual size. A stack of mail on the floor: envelopes with a ringtone company's logo.

image.prompt: a young man drawn noticeably smaller than normal sitting at a drafting table in an ordinary-sized garage panel, a normal-sized dog beside him, a stack of envelopes with a corporate logo on the floor, muddy digital flats
image.notes: Wood at two-thirds size. Everything else normal. Hold this for six weeks of dailies.

panels.composition: GULLY, normal size, in the door.

image.prompt: a normal-sized young man in a backwards cap standing in a garage doorway looking at a much smaller young man at a drafting table

balloons.text: Forty thousand people who came for a helicopter.

image.prompt: close-up of a small young man at a drafting table, resigned

panels.composition: Gully. Wood doesn't answer. The panel is mostly the mail.

image.prompt: a garage panel mostly filled by a stack of envelopes on the floor, a normal-sized man in the doorway and a small man at a table not answering, muddy flats

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The week after. Bragging and mourning in four panels; the lead drawn small to do it.
